title: Presidential Intern
description: The University of Utah's Presidential Internship in Higher Education Leadership provides undergraduate students from diverse fields the opportunity to learn from and collaborate with the president and other university administrators. As a Presidential Intern, I help staff senior administrative offices and work on strategic projects designed to advance the goals of the university. I act as a student representative at various university functions and events, and attend weekly higher education leadership seminars hosted by executive leaders from the campus and larger community. Through this role, I gain practical knowledge and skills in higher education administration, hone leadership abilities, and build a professional network while providing student insight and perspective to help shape the educational experience at the University of Utah.

title: Senior Vice President of Health Sciences Intern
description: As an intern in the Office of the Senior Vice President of Health Sciences at University of Utah Health, I support strategic initiatives and administrative functions within the university's health sciences division. This position allows me to gain firsthand exposure to healthcare administration and leadership while contributing to projects that advance the mission of one of the nation's leading academic medical centers.

title: ASUU Finance Associate Director
description: As Finance Associate Director for the Associated Students of the University of Utah (ASUU), I oversee financial operations and budget management for the university's student government. I work to ensure fiscal responsibility, transparency, and strategic allocation of student funds to support initiatives and programs that enhance the student experience across campus.

title: Business Owner
description: As the owner of StevensED LLC, I established a private educational institution centered on intellectual rigor and high academic standards. I designed multi-year curricular frameworks, developed evidence-based instructional programs, and established rigorous academic expectations that have supported strong student performance across disciplines. The institution now delivers cohesive, outcomes-driven education informed by modern pedagogy.

title: Antibiotic Researcher
description: As an undergraduate researcher in the Antibiotic Discovery stream at the University of Utah, I contribute to the search for novel antimicrobial compounds by isolating and characterizing soil-derived bacteria using culture-dependent methods. This research involves selective enrichment techniques, high-throughput screening against ESKAPE pathogens, and bioassay-guided fractionation to identify active compounds. Through this experience, I've developed hands-on proficiency in microbiology and molecular biology techniques, while contributing to clinically relevant research aimed at combating antibiotic resistance.

title: ASUU Senator
description: As a Senator in the Associated Students of the University of Utah (ASUU), I represent the College of Fine Arts in the university's student government. In this role, I advocate for student interests, participate in legislative processes, and help oversee the allocation of college-level funding through the College Student Council. My work includes legislative drafting, event planning, student advocacy, and serving on committees that shape university-wide policy and governance.

title: Science Ambassador
description: As a Science Ambassador for the University of Utah's College of Science, I serve as a representative for prospective and current students, supporting recruitment, outreach, and student engagement efforts. I lead campus tours, mentor first-year and transfer students, and assist with New Student Orientation and themed community initiatives. I also participate in K–12 STEM outreach events and university-sponsored programs that promote science education and community involvement.
